title: pfaffia glomerata var. squarrosa
intro: Pfaffia glomerata var. squarrosa, commonly known as Yerba Santa, is a type of plant native to the Southwestern United States and Mexico. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving respiratory issues, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Yerba Santa include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as caffeic acid, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes. The plant's bioactive compounds work together to provide a range of health benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional herbal medicine.
